correctness.rationale: For Schmidt form psi=a|00>+b|11> with concurrence c=2ab, rho^{T_B} has spectrum (a^2,b^2,ab,-ab) for a,b>0; its sign is swap F. The trace-norm subgradient gives N(sigma)>=Tr[(|Phi+><Phi+|-I/2)sigma] with equality N(rho)=c/2. Since pure-state negativity is C/2, negativity convexity and concurrence's convex roof yield 2N(sigma)<=C(sigma). Wootters f(C) is increasing and convex; differentiating yields f'(c)=(c/(2r))log((1+r)/(1-r)), f''(c)=[log((1+r)/(1-r))-2r]/(2r^3)>0 with f'(1)=1. Hence Lambda=2f'(c)W+[f(c)-cf'(c)]I supports E_F globally at rho and has diameter 2f'(c). Trace-norm duality |Tr Lambda(rho-sigma)|<=(diam Lambda/2)||rho-sigma||_1 proves the sufficient exactness condition 2f'(c)<=1/lambda for the cited norm-penalty convention. The c=1 derivative limit and c=0 separable lower bound are handled separately. The threshold is sufficient, not proved optimal.
